column1: # AION 2 skill names by skill code, as damage (04 38) and tick (05 38) records
# carry them. A code is 8 digits: the first two are the class (11 Gladiator to
# 18 Chanter, 19 Brawler), code / 10000 is the skill, and the low four digits a
# variant. A variant without a row of its own takes its skill's name. The
# third column, when there is one, names the skill's icon, which
# the site says its data comes from NCSOFT's official AION 2 API. English
# names as the site lists them. Regenerate with tools/gen_skill_table.py.
